<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6616">su ka ta</rs><note type="editorial">Tentative identification of "su ka ta"as Sugataśrī (ID:6616)</note> na re sa brgyad pa la'o ||
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> na re sa bcu pa <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> kyi sa yin <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="61a5"/> pas dgu pa la'o ||
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">dha</rs><note type="editorial">The identity of "dha" is not clear.</note> na re sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod la yin te byang chub sems dpa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
